caption: The drawing depicts a stylized figure standing on a rectangular brown base. The figure appears to be dressed in a long, flowing blue robe with red cuffs and a beige belt at the waist. The robe is decorated with a row of orange circles running vertically down the front, and the fabric has blue wavy lines suggesting folds. The left hand is raised and positioned at chest height, and the right hand is holding up part of the robe to reveal the left leg, which is exposed from the knee down. The exposed leg is flesh-colored with vertical red lines running down from the knee, possibly representing wounds. The figure has a light beige face with simplified, symmetrical features, dark brown short hair arranged in a row of round segments, and is barefoot. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Plate 36: Saint Roch: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
